close_reason: Updated reg! macro in jmap-sharing-server to use ClosureHandlerWithCtx; clippy clean
description:
Update register_sharing_handlers to forward CallerCtx using ClosureHandlerWithCtx<B, C> (from JMAP-exue.1).

All Principal/* and ShareNotification/* handler closures receive ctx: C. Critical for sharing servers where permission enforcement (currently delegated entirely to the backend) needs to know the authenticated principal making the request.

Acceptance criteria:
- register_sharing_handlers closures receive CallerCtx
- cargo test -p jmap-sharing-server exits 0
- Clippy clean

Depends on JMAP-exue.1.
title: jmap-sharing-server: Forward CallerCtx in register_sharing_handlers
